content.rendered:
Order personal and business checks

Averon Trust Bank has partnered with Harland Clarke to enable you to order your personal and business checks and accessories online.  Choose from a wide variety of check styles, options and accessories to suit your personality and the manner in which you manage your finances.

Harland Clarke representatives are available to assist you 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Call toll-free, 1-800-275-1053.

When ordering checks online:

  • Enter your account number and the Averon Trust Bank routing and transit number: 211173357.
  • Upon submitting your order, the purchase amount will be charged directly to your account and your purchase will be shipped to the address that appears on the online check order.

Need to make changes?

You may change the check style and/or the starting check number when ordering.

If you need to change the name or address on your check order or to have your checks delivered to an alternate address, please contact our Customer Care Center at 678-465-8306 during normal business hours.

place your order
